messages:
Maya K: FYI canary at 5% (eu-west-3 / eu5) started showing a small snapback in p95 tail latency ~3m ago. Holding at 5% per runbook. @Sam can you confirm if this is a hotspot or infra noise? :eyes:
Sam: On it. pulling traces and infra metrics now. any recent infra pushes to that region?
Devon: No infra pushes from infra team. Did the model shard rebalancer run?
ops-bot: ALERT: Canary eu-west-3 latency spike detected. p95 increased from 120ms -> 540ms over 6m. 5xx rate stable.
Sam: Logs look like intermittent library-level GC pauses on two hosts (eu5-host-42, eu5-host-43). Also seeing higher KV cache evictions.
Maya K: Ok — sounds like a noisy-host issue. Two options: 1) region pin the canary to alternative eu5 pool, 2) roll back canary to previous model build, 3) keep pinned at 5% and let autoscale/evict settle. Opinions?
Nina: I'd prefer pinning to another pool first, since rollback will lose telemetry. If it's host noise, swapping pool should be quick.
Sam: Agreed. I'll try a soft-pool-swap for the canary slice. If swap fails or error budget uses >20% then roll back.
Devon: +1. Add a temporary routing override: route canary traffic away from eu5-host-42/43. That avoids global change.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: requested action: route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-03-10 --exclude-hosts eu5-host-42,eu5-host-43 --until 1795016000
deploy-bot: status: started routing-change job id rchg-8921
Sam: Running the routing-change now. Patch applied to 3/4 canary instances; one instance hitting socket timeout, retrying.
Maya K: Keep me posted. If patch doesn't fully apply in 5m we plan to pin the canary to eu2 as fallback and open rollback play.
ops-bot: INFO: routing-change rchg-8921: 3 successes, 1 retry pending.
Sam: Retry succeeded. All canary instances now routed to alternate pool. Re-checking p95..
Sam: p95 back to 130ms after routing change. KV eviction rate recovering. No increase in 5xx.
Maya K: Nice. We're good to continue ramp after a 15m observation window. Can we extend the canary window by 30m to be safe?
Devon: Fine with extending. Update on the rollout config?
Maya K: I'll update the change window and annotate release notes: "Extended canary observation by 30m due to transient eu5 host instability; routing override applied; no rollback required."
Nina: Add a follow-up task to drain and reprovision eu5-host-42/43; mark them for maintenance.
Maya K: Will do. Sam — can you close the quick incident once maintenance ticket is open?
Sam: Yep. Opening ticket now: INC-7342 -> reprovision eu5-host-42/43.
ops-bot: NOTE: Canaries remain at 5% until 1795016200 per updated window.
Maya K: Thanks team. No rollback needed. Resuming slow ramp plan after 15m quiet window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: action rchg-8921 completed at 1795012502.
Sam: Closing thread once ticket created and maintenance scheduled.
Maya K: Closing for now — re-open if any regressions.
